name: Ichihara Tokitaka
source:
A Private Special Living Dead Stalker working for the Karasuzumi Living Dead Stalker Agency. Specializes in sniping using his [Url=https://www.nitroplus.co.jp/game/tokyonecro/img/weapon_ogasawara_anim.gif]Ogasawara TFD-20[/url].

[Spoiler]His father was a Necromancer killed by [url=/c41455]Karasuzumi Ikkatsu[/url].[/spoiler]

A math fetishist with a sharp tongue. Not many people get along with him.

[From the in-game profile]
